item.tib: srid pa'i rgyal mo nang bdud mo bsgrab pa'i mngon rtogs
item.coloph: srid pa'i rgyal mo nang bdud mo ru sgrubs (sgrub) pa'i bskyed rim 'di ni/ gzhung don bsdus nas blo dman don du bdag gi (gis) 'di ru skad (bkod) do/ 'gal 'khrul mchis na mkha' 'gro gnyen la bshags/ dge ba'i (bas) 'gro kun don gnyis lhun grub shog/
